referenceFunction.generalComment: Modern Swiss technologies for regional storage facilities, material extraction, and asphalt production. Based on survey data from 73 asphalt mixing plants. UUID: ad2d0051-6556-4a86-a65d-853179580a25
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset covers the production of average Asphalt Concrete (AC T) base layers in Switzerland, with 30% reclaimed asphalt. The process represents an average AC T, derived from the mean material composition of multiple AC T S, AC T N, AC T L and AC T H layers. It includes raw material extraction, transportation, and manufacturing processes.
